description: Source code implementing a menu box interface for a dialog system, including functions for rendering menu items, handling user input, scrolling, and displaying buttons and arrows within a terminal UI.

methods.name: do_print_item
methods.description: Prints a menu item in the window, highlighting if selected and marking hotkeys.

methods.name: print_arrows
methods.description: Displays scroll indicators (arrows) in the menu window.

methods.name: print_buttons
methods.description: Displays control buttons ('Select', 'Exit', 'Help', 'Save', 'Load') at the bottom of the dialog.

methods.name: do_scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the menu window up or down by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: dialog_menu
methods.description: Main function to display a scrollable menu dialog, handle user input, and return selection.
